procs.rm: Copper concentrate (25-32% Cu, imported via shipping for most Indian smelters)
procs.out: Dried, blended concentrate ready for smelter feed
procs.q: Cu%, Fe%, S%, As/Sb/Bi/Pb (deleterious elements), Au/Ag (payable), moisture %, particle size

d: Analyses multi-element assay data from each concentrate batch (Cu, Fe, S, As, Sb, Bi, Pb, Au, Ag) integrated with shipment, supplier and contract data.
Tracks payable Cu/Au/Ag and penalty elements (As, Sb, Bi, Hg) against contract terms.
Provides reconciliation between supplier assay, plant assay and umpire if applicable; flags discrepancies.
p: Concentrate assay drives commercial settlement (high financial stake)
Penalty elements (As, Bi) hit on every shipment
Discrepancies caught late in payment cycle
uc.calc: Assay reconciliation error reduction 0.1-0.3% × concentrate value ₹5-6 lakh/t × 3.5 t conc/t Cu = ₹15-50K/t Cu = ₹15-50 cr/MTPA. Capture 5-10% = ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses concentrate stockpile inventory, assays, smelter operational constraints (Cu/S ratio, deleterious elements, heat balance) and downstream feedback.
Models optimal blend recipes for stable smelter operation at minimum penalty element risk.
Provides daily blend recipe advisory with traceability.
p: Blending often by experience, not optimization
Stockpile assays not always up to date
Smelter operational disruptions traced back to bad blends
uc.calc: Smelter stability + reduced penalty events + improved matte grade consistency. ₹4 cr per MTPA copper.

uc.t: Material Handling Health & Foreign Material Detection
loc: Storage silo discharge to dryer feed
Dryer to smelter feed conveyor (final checkpoint)
d: Analyses camera feeds, vibration on idlers, and metal detector signals.
Detects belt tears, mis-tracking, foreign material and bearing degradation.
Provides location-tagged alerts before unplanned conveyor failures.
p: Concentrate handling lines failure halts smelter feed
Belt damage often noticed only on inspection rounds
uc.calc: Belt failure prevention + jam events avoided. ₹1 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Dried concentrate, silica flux, recycled materials, fuel (HFO/NG)
procs.ut: Oxygen (95%+ purity), combustion air, fuel, power
procs.out: Matte (60-70% Cu), slag, off-gas (25-35% SO2 to acid plant)
procs.q: Matte grade %, Cu-in-slag %, off-gas SO2 strength, slag fluidity, thermal efficiency

d: Analyses concentrate feed rate and assay, oxygen flow, fuel rate, bath temperature and matte grade lab data.
Models smelter thermodynamics and predicts matte grade, slag chemistry and SO2 generation versus operating conditions.
Provides advisory on O2 enrichment, fuel rate and matte target for stable, efficient operation.
p: Matte grade target hit via experience
Fuel cost rising; consumption above design
uc.calc: O2 savings 5% × ₹50-80 cr/MTPA O2 cost + fuel savings 3-5% + matte grade stability for downstream. ₹8 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses slag composition (Fe/SiO2 ratio, Cu%, magnetite content), slag temperature/fluidity, and matte settling.
Models slag-matte separation thermodynamics and predicts Cu losses versus slag chemistry.
Provides flux addition advisory and slag chemistry setpoints to minimize Cu carried in discard slag.
p: Flux addition by recipe, not optimized
uc.calc: Cu-in-slag reduction 0.2-0.4% × slag rate 3-4 t/t Cu × ₹6.5 lakh/t Cu × 1 MTPA = ₹15-25 cr. Conservative ₹15 cr per MTPA copper.

uc.t: Off-gas SO2 Capture & Acid Plant Feed Optimization
d: Analyses smelter off-gas SO2 strength, temperature, particulate load and acid plant feed conditions.
Models smelter-to-acid-plant integration and identifies SO2 capture inefficiencies.
Provides advisory on smelter feed timing and acid plant gas conditioning for maximum SO2 capture.
p: Off-gas SO2 variability hurts acid plant
uc.calc: SO2 capture +1-2 percentage points × 3 t acid/t Cu × ₹2,500/t acid + compliance margin. ₹6 cr per MTPA copper.

uc.t: Smelter Refractory Wear & Campaign Life Monitoring
d: Analyses thermal imaging of refractory shell, lance/wall temperatures and operating conditions correlated with historical campaign life.
Predicts refractory wear patterns and remaining campaign life.
Provides relining schedule advisory and operational adjustments to extend campaign.
p: Refractory relining is expensive (₹10-25 cr per campaign + 15-30 day shutdown)
Wear pattern emerges late in campaign
uc.calc: Campaign life extension 10-15% + reduced unplanned relines. ₹4 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses concentrate burner performance, O2 lance behavior, combustion efficiency and feed segregation.
Models burner heat release and oxygen utilization patterns.
Provides burner setpoint advisory for maximum O2 efficiency and stable bath operation.
uc.calc: O2 efficiency improvement 2-3%. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

uc.t: Smelter Mass Balance & Cu Accounting Inferential
d: Integrates concentrate input, matte output, slag output and off-gas data with multi-element assays.
Builds real-time copper mass balance and identifies unaccounted Cu losses.
Provides Cu accounting closure dashboards and discrepancy investigation tools.
p: Cu in process not tracked precisely
uc.calc: Accounting closure improvement + reduced unaccounted Cu losses. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Matte from smelter (~65% Cu), silica flux for slag-making
procs.ut: Oxygen-enriched air (28-30% O2), auxiliary fuel, power
procs.out: Blister copper (~98-99% Cu), converter slag (recycled to smelter), off-gas with SO2
procs.q: Blister Cu%, S%, O%, cycle time, oxygen utilization %, refractory wear

d: Analyses converter blow times (slag-making + copper-making), matte input quality, O2 enrichment and converter slag chemistry.
Models converter cycle dynamics and predicts blow endpoints.
Provides cycle optimization advisory for maximum copper throughput at target quality.
uc.calc: Cycle time reduction 5-10% × copper margin. ₹6 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses O2 enrichment ratio, blast rate, off-gas O2 content and converter performance.
Models O2 utilization at converter and predicts optimal enrichment per cycle stage.
Provides O2 dosing setpoint advisory.
p: O2 enrichment manually set per cycle
uc.calc: O2 cost reduction 3-5% on converter. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses high-temperature camera feeds at converter mouth during charging, blowing and skimming.
Detects slag/matte interface, splashing events, mouth buildup and refractory wear visible at mouth.
Provides operational alerts and quality scoring for skim cycle endpoints.
uc.calc: Improved skim quality + reduced splash events + mouth maintenance. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses thermal imaging of converter shell, tuyere health and operational stress markers.
Predicts refractory wear and lining campaign life.
Provides relining scheduling advisory.
uc.calc: Campaign extension + reduced unplanned relines. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.ut: Reductant (NG or LPG), combustion air, power (rotary drive)
procs.out: Anode-grade copper (~99.5%), set to target oxygen content for casting
procs.q: Final S% (<0.005%), O% (0.15-0.25% target), Pb/Bi/As content, temperature

d: Analyses anode furnace blow profile (oxidation removes S, reduction sets O), bath temperature and final anode quality.
Models S and O endpoint kinetics and predicts target O content (0.15-0.25%) for downstream cell house.
Provides reductant dosing and blow duration setpoint advisory.
uc.calc: Reductant savings + cycle time + downstream cathode quality. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Refined anode copper from anode furnace
procs.out: Cast copper anodes (~330-380 kg each, dimensionally consistent for cell house)
procs.q: Anode weight tolerance, surface quality, dimensional accuracy, structural integrity

d: Analyses cameras at casting wheel exit and anode stacking line; detects casting defects (cold shut, porosity, deformation, mold issues).
Provides defect classification and rejects bad anodes before cell house feed.
Tracks defect patterns to mold/casting wheel for root cause.
p: Anode defects cause cell house disruption (short circuits, current efficiency loss)
Mold wear hidden until anode quality drops
kpi: Cathode quality from anode defect (downstream impact)
uc.calc: Defect reduction + cell house disruption avoidance. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses real-time anode weight and dimensions at casting wheel output.
Detects deviations from target anode spec (weight tolerance, shape, dimensions).
Provides immediate operational alerts and casting wheel adjustment guidance.
p: Anode weight variability impacts cell house
Dimensional issues cause cell short circuits
uc.calc: Weight + dimension consistency reducing cell house disruption. ₹2 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Copper anodes, stainless steel permanent cathodes (or starter sheets), electrolyte (CuSO4 + H2SO4)
procs.ut: DC power (250-320 A/m² current density, 0.25-0.35 V per cell), heated electrolyte (60-65°C)
procs.out: LME-grade cathode copper (>99.99% Cu), depleted anode scrap (recycled), anode slimes (precious metals)
procs.q: Current efficiency (CE %), specific energy (kWh/t Cu), cathode purity, electrolyte composition (Cu, H2SO4, Fe, As, Sb, Ni)

d: Analyses current density, electrolyte temperature, electrolyte flow, anode-cathode geometry, electrolyte composition and historical cell performance data.
Models cell electrochemistry plant-wide and predicts current efficiency versus operating conditions.
Provides advisory on current density, electrolyte flow, additive dosing for maximum CE at target cathode quality.
p: Cell house consumes 40-50% of plant power
Current density limited by quality risk
uc.calc: CE improvement 1-2 percentage points × 280 kWh/t Cu specific energy × ₹6/kWh × 1 MTPA = ₹15-30 cr. ₹15 cr per MTPA copper conservatively.

d: Analyses high-resolution cameras at cathode stripping machines.
Detects cathode surface defects (nodules, dendrites, pits, discoloration), thickness anomalies and stripping issues.
Provides defect classification with cell-level tracking for root cause.
p: Premium LME-A cathodes earn $50-100/t over standard
Quality drift only caught by sampling
uc.calc: Premium grade share +3-5% × $50-100/t premium × 1 MTPA × ₹83/$. ₹6 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses electrolyte Cu, H2SO4, Fe, As, Sb, Bi, Ni levels, bleed rate and makeup feed.
Models impurity buildup kinetics and predicts cathode quality risk versus electrolyte state.
Provides bleed/purification setpoint advisory to maintain target electrolyte at minimum chemical/energy cost.
p: Impurity buildup hidden until cathode quality drops
Bleed rate often conservative (excess purification cost)
uc.calc: Bleed optimization + cathode quality. ₹4 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses thermal imaging of cell house aisles, individual cell temperatures and infrared anode-cathode gap profiles.
Detects short circuits, hot spots, abnormal cell behavior in real time.
Provides immediate alerts to cell house operators for intervention.
p: Manual aisle patrol cannot cover continuously
uc.calc: Short circuit time reduction × CE recovery. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses cell-by-cell slimes generation rates, settling characteristics, and cell cleaning effectiveness.
Identifies slimes loss to electrolyte circulation and anode washing inefficiencies.
Provides cell cleaning schedule and slimes recovery advisory.
p: Anode slimes contain valuable PMs (Au, Ag, Se, Te)
Slimes loss to circulation reduces PM yield
PM revenue often largest profit driver
uc.calc: PM yield improvement 1-2% × slimes value (Au, Ag, PGMs). ₹5 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses CCTV across cell house aisles for personnel safety, equipment integrity and process anomalies.
Detects acid mist, electrolyte leaks, restricted-zone entry without PPE.
Provides safety alerts and area-tagged incidents.
p: Cell house has H2SO4 mist + electrolyte splash hazards
uc.calc: Incident prevention + compliance + asset protection. ₹2 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: SO2-rich off-gas from smelter and converter (cleaned, dried)
procs.ut: Air (combustion + drying), water, electricity, V2O5 catalyst, demin water (absorber)
procs.out: Sulphuric acid (98-99% concentration, saleable to fertilizer/chemical industries)
procs.q: SO2-to-SO3 conversion %, acid quality, mist emissions (mg/Nm³), stack SO2 ppm

d: Analyses converter bed temperatures, SO2 feed strength, catalyst activity and final acid quality.
Models catalyst kinetics across 4 beds and predicts overall conversion versus operating conditions.
Provides advisory on bed temperatures, feed strength and interpass cooling for maximum conversion.
p: Conversion target 99.5-99.7%; below = stack emission risk
uc.calc: Conversion +0.1-0.3% × 3 t acid/t Cu × ₹2,500/t acid + reduced catalyst replacement. ₹5 cr per MTPA copper.

uc.t: Acid Mist Emission & Absorption Tower Optimization
d: Analyses absorption tower performance, acid mist emissions and acid quality.
Predicts acid mist levels versus operating conditions.
Provides setpoint advisory for absorption tower operation.
p: Mist plumes are visible compliance issue
uc.calc: Compliance margin + reduced demister replacement. ₹2 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses HRS (Heat Recovery System) performance, steam generation from acid plant exothermic, and heat integration with plant steam network.
Models heat recovery potential and predicts steam generation versus operating mode.
Provides advisory on HRS operation for maximum steam recovery.
uc.calc: Steam generation uplift + reduced auxiliary boiler fuel. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Anode slimes from cell house (contain residual Cu, Au, Ag, Se, Te, Pb, Bi, As, possibly PGMs)
procs.ut: Steam (decopperization), power, leaching chemicals (H2SO4, NaOH), smelting energy
procs.out: Refined Au, Ag (dore bars), Se, Te, residual Pb/Bi/As streams
procs.q: PM recovery %, refined metal purity (>99.9% Au/Ag), throughput (t slimes/day)

uc.t: Anode Slimes Processing & PM Recovery Optimization
d: Analyses slimes input composition (Cu, Au, Ag, Se, Te, Pb, Bi), roasting/leaching parameters and final metal recovery.
Models multi-element separation chemistry and predicts PM yield versus operating conditions.
Provides recovery advisory and process optimization for maximum Au/Ag/Se/Te recovery.
p: PMs represent 5-15% of plant profit despite tiny mass throughput
Lab feedback slow on PM grade
uc.calc: Au recovery improvement 0.5-1% × Au content × LBMA price + Ag yield uplift + Se/Te. ₹10 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Integrates LIMS data for Au, Ag, Se, Te, PGMs across slimes processing stages.
Builds real-time mass balance for each precious metal and identifies recovery losses.
Provides PM accounting dashboards and yield investigation tools.
uc.calc: Accounting closure + reduced unaccounted PM losses. ₹4 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses Se/Te recovery process performance, reagent consumption and product quality.
Models Se/Te separation chemistry and predicts recovery and purity.
Provides recovery setpoint advisory for these specialty byproducts.
uc.calc: Se/Te recovery uplift + product quality premium. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Copper cathodes (LME grade A, >99.99%), possibly with copper scrap blending
procs.ut: Power (induction shaft furnace), gas (reducing atmosphere), cooling water, lubricants
procs.out: Copper rod (8mm typical) on coils (~5 tonne) for wire drawing applications
procs.q: Surface quality, oxygen content (<300 ppm ETP grade, <30 ppm OF grade), dimensional tolerance, hardness

d: Analyses melting furnace operations, casting wheel speed, rolling mill load and downstream quality feedback.
Models rod production kinetics and predicts surface quality, dimensional accuracy and throughput.
Provides rolling schedule and casting speed advisory.
p: Rod throughput is bottleneck for downstream wire customers
uc.calc: Throughput uplift + quality improvement. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper rod.

d: Analyses high-speed line scan cameras at rolling mill exit and post-pickling.
Detects surface defects (cracks, slivers, scale, drawing marks) on rod.
Provides defect classification and reject diversion.
p: Surface defects cause wire drawing failures at customer
uc.calc: Reject reduction + customer complaint reduction. ₹2 cr per MTPA copper rod.

uc.t: Oxygen Content Control (ETP vs OF Grades)
d: Analyses melting furnace gas composition, casting line atmosphere and oxygen meter readings.
Models oxygen pickup/loss kinetics and predicts final rod oxygen content.
Provides shaft furnace operation advisory to hit target oxygen (ETP <300 ppm, OF <30 ppm).
p: ETP and OF grades earn different prices
uc.calc: Grade compliance + premium grade share. ₹2 cr per MTPA copper rod.

d: Analyses online laser gauges of rod diameter and ovality, plus coil mass tracking.
Detects dimensional drift and rolling mill issues affecting tolerance.
Provides operational alerts for tolerance management.
uc.calc: Dimensional compliance + customer satisfaction. ₹2 cr per MTPA copper rod.

procs.rm: Grid power, captive power generation, plant-wide load profile
procs.out: Optimized power distribution to plant (cell house dominant, smelter auxiliary)
procs.q: Specific power consumption (MWh/t Cu), peak demand, power factor, demand charges

d: Analyses plant-wide power demand profile (cell house dominant, smelter/converter intermittent, utilities steady).
Models power demand patterns and predicts peak load events.
Provides demand management advisory, peak shaving and load coordination.
p: Cell house is 40-50% of plant power
uc.calc: Peak demand reduction + power factor improvement. ₹4 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Steam from acid plant heat recovery + auxiliary boilers
procs.out: Steam delivered to anode slimes processing, concentrate drying, deaeration, building heating
procs.q: Header pressures, flow distribution, condensate recovery%, venting losses

d: Analyses steam flows from acid plant HRS and auxiliary boiler, headers and consumers (anode slimes processing, concentrate drying).
Models steam balance and identifies inefficient consumers.
Provides distribution and consumption advisory.
p: Steam network smaller than other industries but real
uc.calc: Network optimization + trap management. ₹2 cr per MTPA copper.

loc: HRS-side steam headers and drip legs
Anode slimes processing reactor and evaporator drains
Distribution and tracing line drainage points
d: Analyses inlet and outlet temperature signatures from wireless battery-powered sensors deployed at each steam trap.
Detects failed-open, failed-closed and failed-cold conditions using temperature delta logic.
Provides location-tagged alerts for proactive replacement.
p: Copper plant has 500-1,500 steam traps (smaller infrastructure than pulp/steel but real)
Manual inspection cannot cover full population
uc.calc: Trap failure rate 15% × ~1,000 traps × ₹3 lakh/yr × 50% capture = ₹2 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Combined plant effluent (acid mine drainage, cell house bleed, acid plant blowdown, area washings)
procs.ut: Power (aerators, pumps), chemicals (lime, polymer, sulphide precipitant), sludge handling
procs.out: Treated effluent (within state PCB limits), copper-bearing sludge (recycled to smelter)
procs.q: Outlet Cu/heavy metals (mg/L), pH, sulphate, TSS, COD

d: Analyses inlet effluent characteristics (Cu, Pb, As, Sb, Zn, sulphate, pH), treatment chemical dosing and outlet quality.
Models heavy metal precipitation kinetics and predicts outlet compliance.
Provides dosing advisory and sludge management optimization.
p: Copper ETP must remove multiple heavy metals
Sludge contains valuable Cu (recycle to smelter)
uc.calc: Chemical optimization + Cu-in-sludge recovery. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.out: Compressed air (instrument + plant) and oxygen-enriched air feed
procs.q: Network pressure (bar), flow (Nm3/h), dew point, leak rate %

d: Analyses compressor load, network pressure, flow at consumers and leak rates.
Detects compressor cycling, leaks and pressure drops.
Provides advisory on compressor sequencing and network repairs.
uc.calc: Leak reduction + sequencing. ₹1 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: OT data (DCS/PLC), MES, ERP, LIMS, IoT sensor streams
procs.ut: Edge gateways, network infrastructure, cloud compute, storage
procs.out: Unified data layer enabling all AI use cases
procs.q: Tag coverage %, data quality, latency, uptime, governance compliance

uc.vt: Enabler for all other use cases
d: Foundational data layer: unified namespace, historian access, MES integration, ERP linkage, LIMS integration (especially critical for multi-element copper assays).
Enables every other AI use case by providing reliable, tagged, contextual data.
Provides time-series storage, governance, role-based access and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
p: Plant data scattered across DCS, PLC, lab, ERP
Multi-element LIMS data not integrated with operations
Analytics projects start with data plumbing every time
uc.calc: Enabler — value realized through downstream use cases.

procs.rm: Lab samples (concentrate, slag, matte, blister, anode, cathode, slimes, acid), online sensors, customer specs
procs.ut: Lab instruments (XRF, ICP-OES, fire assay), LIMS, calibration standards
procs.out: Multi-element quality intelligence, COA, mass balance integrity, traceability
procs.q: Multi-element spec compliance, lab TAT, mass balance closure, COA accuracy

d: Integrates lab quality data (concentrate, slag, matte, blister, anode, cathode, slimes, acid) with online process data.
Provides multi-element mass balance, payable metal tracking, and quality intelligence across all process streams.
Provides early warning on quality drift and faster lab-to-process feedback loops.
p: Copper plant has dense LIMS environment (10+ elements at every stage)
uc.calc: Quality drift reduction + mass balance closure + customer audit acceleration. ₹4 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Sensor data (vibration, temp, oil, motor current), maintenance history, spare parts data
procs.ut: Edge processing, CBM platform, CMMS software, MRO inventory system
procs.out: Failure predictions, work orders, reliability KPIs, optimized spares
procs.q: Equipment availability %, MTBF, MTTR, maintenance cost/t Cu, unplanned downtime hours

d: Analyses vibration, temperature, oil quality and motor signature data from critical rotating equipment (smelter blowers, converter aisle cranes, rectifier transformers, cell house pumps, casting wheels, rolling mills).
Predicts bearing failures, alignment issues, lubrication problems and impending breakdowns.
Provides location-tagged alerts and remaining-useful-life estimates.
p: Smelter or converter unplanned shutdown is catastrophic (₹2-5 cr/day)
uc.calc: Unplanned downtime reduction × copper margin × hours saved. ₹15 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Workflow management for maintenance work orders, planned/unplanned tracking, asset history and maintenance KPIs.
Integrates CBM alerts into work order generation and tracks closure.
Provides asset-level reliability metrics (MTBF, MTTR), maintenance cost reporting and compliance audit trails.
p: Work orders don't close on time
uc.calc: Work order closure reduction + maintenance cost transparency. ₹5 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses spare parts inventory, lead times, criticality, consumption patterns and supplier reliability.
Models optimal stocking levels, reorder points and consignment opportunities for critical spares (refractory, electrodes, rectifier components, mill rolls).
Provides inventory optimization advisory and supplier performance dashboards.
uc.calc: Inventory reduction 15-25% + emergency procurement savings. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: CCTV feeds, gas detection (SO2, H2SO4 mist, H2S), thermal imaging, access control
procs.ut: CV platform, edge inference, SCM integration, alert infrastructure
procs.out: Real-time safety alerts, compliance reports, near-miss analytics
procs.q: PPE compliance %, restricted zone violations, hot metal splash events, gas exposure events, LTIFR

d: Critical zones: smelter floor (hot metal splash), converter aisle (high-temp + SO2), cell house aisles (H2SO4 mist), acid plant, slimes processing.
Analyses CCTV with computer vision (PPE, restricted-zone, hot metal proximity) integrated with SO2, H2SO4 mist, and thermal sensors.
Provides real-time alerts to control room and safety officers; integrates with site SCM.
p: Hot metal splashes are serious risk
SO2 exposure has acute and chronic effects
uc.calc: Incident avoidance + insurance + compliance audit. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: All plant data (production, multi-element quality, energy, maintenance, ERP, financial)
procs.ut: Cloud compute, BI platform, scheduling engine, mass balance engine
procs.out: Plant-wide OEE, Cu accounting, payable metals tracking, scenario analysis
procs.q: OEE%, throughput, conversion cost (₹/t Cu), Cu accounting closure %, payable PM yield

d: Integrates production, multi-element quality, energy, downtime and PM yield data across all sections into role-based dashboards.
Provides automated OEE, specific energy, conversion cost, Cu accounting and payable PM tracking; root cause analysis tools.
Enables data-driven decision making at all levels.
uc.calc: Systemic OEE + energy + PM KPI tracking. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

d: Analyses concentrate availability, smelter/converter/cell house capacities, cathode demand forecasts and rod plant orders.
Models scheduling sequences and predicts margin per scenario.
Provides optimal schedule and grade sequence recommendations.
uc.calc: Reduced changeover loss + improved capacity utilization. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.

procs.rm: Air emission data (SO2, mist, particulate), effluent data, GHG emissions, chain of custody
procs.out: Compliance reports, ESG metrics, copper mark/ASI traceability, carbon footprint
procs.q: Emission limit margins, audit findings, certified product %, carbon intensity per t Cu

d: Tracks SO2 emissions, GHG (CO2e), water footprint, heavy metal effluent, and chain of custody for Copper Mark / ASI / responsible sourcing.
Integrates with regulatory reporting (CPCB) and customer ESG audits.
Provides compliance dashboards and certified product tracking.
uc.calc: Certified product premium + compliance + customer brand requirements. ₹3 cr per MTPA copper.
